description: An execution withdrawn before submission ("Ended: cancelled", "Cancelled before submission", run not established) shows the verdict form and Record artifact form, and the server accepts a Human acceptance for it. The card then reads "Execution cancelled · Human acceptance accepted by Maya Okafor" for work that never reached T3.
expected: No verdict or artifact forms for executions that never ran, and the server refuses verdicts when no run was established.
actual: POST /executions/verdicts returned 200, and the acceptance is shown on the card.
suggested_fix: Hide the verdict and artifact forms when the execution has no runId (as for abandoned), and refuse verdicts server-side for executions that are cancelled before submission.

description: Withdrawing a queued follow-up discards it. To fix a small mistake, Maya must retype the whole follow-up, because there is no 'Edit and requeue' and the withdrawn text is not put back in the textarea.
expected: Withdraw offers to put the text back in the follow-up box, or the queued text can be edited while it is still queued.
actual: The text is shown only on the cancelled card and must be retyped.
suggested_fix: After Withdraw, prefill the follow-up textarea with the withdrawn text (with an undo), or add 'Edit' on queued rows.

description: 'Ended: cancelled' is drawn in the same green as 'Ended: completed' and 'Read 1s ago', while the reason box under it is amber. The colour does not separate success from cancellation.
expected: A neutral or grey colour for cancelled or withdrawn, and green only for completed.
actual: Green for both completed and cancelled.
suggested_fix: Map the end states to distinct tokens (completed = success, cancelled/interrupted = neutral, failed = danger).
